plugins.name: Only people in your web of trust
plugins.description: Accept posts only from people you follow, the people they follow, and so on up to the depth you choose.

plugins.name: Block words and phrases
plugins.description: Turn away, quietly hide, or hold for review any post containing words you list.

plugins.name: Only allow certain kinds of posts
plugins.description: Accept only the kinds of content you choose (for example profiles, notes and reactions) and turn everything else away.

plugins.name: Stop bursts of posts
plugins.description: Let people post a short burst quickly, then slow them down to a steady pace. Stops floods without bothering normal users.

plugins.name: Require a verified address to post
plugins.description: Only people with a verified Nostr address (like name@example.com) on their profile can post. Results are remembered so checks stay fast.
